accuracyFlags.claim: 'Dogs are prohibited on most public conservation land ... A few campsites permit them; the majority do not, and a permit is required in some areas.' (lib/content/rules.ts line 6). 'A few' understates it; minor wording problem.
accuracyFlags.correct: Most DOC campsites ban dogs (207 of 287 in the app's DOC campsite data, about 72%); about a quarter allow them in some form (42 on a leash, 5 unrestricted, 27 with a DOC permit; 74 of 287). Dogs are never allowed in national park campsites. Suggested: 'Most DOC campsites do not allow dogs; about a quarter do, on a leash or with a DOC permit. Check the specific campsite page.'

rejectedFlags: Quiet hours 10 pm-7 am and 10 am checkout: correct per DOC Huts, Campsites, Cabins and Lodges T&Cs (May 2025) cl. 27 and 30.
Unused multi-day bookings cancelled after the first missed night: correct per cl. 23 (unless the site office is contacted within 24 hours; no refund).
No 2026-dated fees/sources: page states no fee, so nothing is out of date; the cited DOC terms page is current.
editorialSuggestions: Optional: cite clause numbers (cl. 23, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32, 33) and add the 24-hour contact nuance; cite DOC's drone page.
auditorFlagsBefore: 'Standard DOC terms set quiet hours from 10 pm to 7 am ... checkout generally by 10 am' - stated as national DOC terms with no cited clause; verify against DOC booking terms and date it.
'Unused multi-day bookings can be cancelled after the first missed night' - verify against current DOC accommodation terms.

'Dogs prohibited on most public conservation land. A few campsites permit them' - app data shows 74 of 287 DOC campsites allow dogs in some form (about 26%), so 'a few' undersells; dogs page gives a different framing.
No fee, pass price or season is dated for 2026 and the only official link is the generic booking-terms page.
'Drones require a concession on public conservation land in most circumstances' - fine but cite DOC drone page.
